entities.name: Query protein GlmU
observations: 455 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular mass 51.7 kDa and pI 10.0.
Matches reviewed GlmU homologs at 48.2–48.6% identity over 96.0–97.6% of the sequence, E-values 5.7e-140 to 1.95e-140.
Contains N-terminal NTP transferase domains and C-terminal glucosamine-1-phosphate acetyltransferase-associated features by Pfam scanning.
Homology supports a bifunctional role in UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis; exact activity is inferred from curated homologs rather than directly assayed for this sequence.

entities.name: Bacterial GlmU
observations: Bifunctional enzyme catalyzing the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis.
C-terminal activity transfers an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA to glucosamine-1-phosphate, producing N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate and CoA.
N-terminal activity transfers UMP from UTP to N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate, producing UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and pyrophosphate.
Curated homologs annotate EC 2.3.1.157 and EC 2.7.7.23 and Mg2+ binding.

entities.name: GlmU acetyltransferase reaction
observations: Corresponds to EC 2.3.1.157 and Rhea RHEA:13725 in curated homolog annotations.

entities.name: GlmU uridyltransferase reaction
observations: Corresponds to EC 2.7.7.23 and Rhea RHEA:13509 in curated homolog annotations.
